questionsAndSelectedAnswers.question: For the new padlock D shading studies, may they use softer in-between colours, or only the exact approved theme colours?
questionsAndSelectedAnswers.selectedOptionText: Each material (body, shackle) may add up to 2 tones derived from its own theme colour, same hue, between the existing shadow and highlight.

questionsAndSelectedAnswers.question: May I use 3 new attempts for the three style studies (soft rounded, restrained bevel, mostly flat with small highlights): one initial attempt each, no corrections, stopping for your style choice?
questionsAndSelectedAnswers.selectedOptionText: One attempt per study on the brass-body / blue-gray-shackle theme, logged as a new extension on top of the existing 12/18 used. I stop at your style choice; any polishing needs a separate approval.

limits: Palette: at most 2 added tones per material, same hue as that material's theme colour, lying between its existing shadow and highlight. Budget: exactly three style-study attempts (soft-rounded, restrained-bevel, mostly-flat-highlights), one initial pass each, no corrective passes, no borrowing; stop at style choice, a genuine blocker or the ceiling. No artwork approval, silhouette change, polishing budget or finished-art approval is granted.
